decisions.reason: The ID Vault was announced publicly as a groundbreaking feature and fits the identity-centered super-app strategy, so management will defend it rather than admit the launch was a mistake.

The identity-bound wallet got only a mention, so little is visibly committed, but it supports the payment pillar of the super-app vision and may be folded into the wallet framework rather than dropped outright.
The NFC tag authenticator is a peripheral hardware item that was only mentioned, with little public commitment or investment, so dropping it costs little and needs no justification.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and is a core part of the announced platform direction, so the investment and visible commitment favor persisting with it.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the super-app core around which the firm has publicly built its strategy, so dropping it would undermine the whole announced direction.
The application shielding library has its own page and builds on the firm's long-standing patented app-security expertise, so it represents deep investment and identity that management will keep.
